PR #84 · feat(auth): migrate auth from Firebase to Supabase
by @meera-k · opened 2026-03-12 · merged 2026-03-12 · labels: auth, P0

## Why

Firebase free tier hit limits during fest sign-ups: the daily email-link quota ran out on 9 and 11 March and about 200 people were stuck on the "check your inbox" screen. Upgrading to the Blaze plan needs a credit card the club does not have.

## What

- Supabase Auth (magic link + Google) replaces Firebase Authentication
- API verifies Supabase JWTs (`SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET`) instead of Firebase ID tokens
- `scripts/import-firebase-users.ts` imports existing users by email
- Firebase project stays read-only until May, then we delete it

## Testing

Tested Google sign-in and magic link locally and on a Render preview.

Closes #14

# FestFlow
Registration and ticketing for **Kalrav 2026**, the annual cultural fest of
Vidyanagar College of Engineering (VCE), Pune. Fest dates: 30 April to 2 May 2026.
FestFlow handles event registration, team sign-ups, payments, QR e-tickets and
gate check-in for 41 events and an expected 6,000+ attendees.
## Repo layout
- `apps/web`: Next.js frontend (participant site and the admin desk)
- `apps/api`: Express + Prisma API
- `apps/scanner`: gate check-in PWA (camera QR scanner, works offline)
- `services/email-templates`: MJML email templates and the mail sender
- `packages/shared`: zod schemas and types shared by web and api
chunks.author: Meera Kulkarni

chunks.text:
## Stack
- Auth: Firebase Authentication (Google sign-in and email link)
- Database: PostgreSQL
- Hosting: Vercel, with a preview deploy for every PR
- Payments: not decided yet (see #payments on Discord)
## Running locally
```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env   # ask Meera for the dev values
npm run dev            # web on :3000, api on :4000
```
Requires Node 20+. On Windows use WSL; native Windows builds are not supported yet.
## Contributing
- Branch from `main`, open a PR, and get one approval from @meera-k before merging.
- Conventional commits: `feat(api): ...`, `fix(web): ...`.
- Ask in #dev on Discord before adding a dependency.
## Contact
Tech team: [REDACTED:EMAIL-1]
chunks.author: Meera Kulkarni

# FestFlow architecture
_Last edited by Meera Kulkarni, 18 Jan 2026_
## Overview
FestFlow is a small monorepo with three deployables: the web app, the API and
the gate scanner PWA. Email templates are a build-time package used by the API.
There is a single production environment and no staging.
## Auth
We use Firebase Authentication for participant login (Google sign-in and email
link). The API verifies Firebase ID tokens with firebase-admin and maps the uid
to a `participant` row. Admin desk access is an allow-list of emails.
## Data
PostgreSQL holds participants, events, teams, registrations, payments and
tickets. Prisma migrations live in `apps/api/prisma`. The production database
URL and password are set as environment variables on the host; they are not in
the repo.
chunks.author: Meera Kulkarni

chunks.text:
## Payments
Gateway not chosen yet. Whatever we pick must support UPI, send a signed
webhook, and allow refunds through the API.
## Tickets and check-in
Each paid registration gets a ticket ID and a QR code. The scanner PWA must be
able to verify tickets offline and sync check-ins when it gets network back.
Hostel and auditorium Wi-Fi is unreliable, so offline verification is a hard
requirement.
## Email
`services/email-templates` renders MJML templates (confirmation, ticket,
reminder, refund) and sends through the provider configured in `MAIL_PROVIDER`.
Currently Gmail SMTP from the club account.
## Refunds
Refund policy: full refund on request until 15 April 2026; no refunds after
15 Apr. Refunds are triggered from the admin desk and processed through the
gateway API.
chunks.author: Meera Kulkarni

chunks.text:
## Environments
- dev: local, seeded with `npm run db:seed`
- prod: single environment, no staging

Q5: How do you deploy to production, and how do you roll back a bad deploy?
A (Meera Kulkarni, 23 Apr 2026): Every push to main auto-deploys both services on Render, no manual step. To roll back, open the service in the Render dashboard, go to Events, pick the last good deploy and click Rollback. Database migrations are not rolled back by Render: run prisma migrate from your laptop against prod, carefully, and take a manual backup first. The reminder cron deploys with the api service, so avoid deploying around 9am IST.
chunks.author: Meera Kulkarni

Q9: "Build fails on Windows" has been reported 7 times. What is the real fix, and what should new volunteers do today?

gapQuestions.question: How do you deploy to production, and how do you roll back a bad deploy?
gapQuestions.rationale: Checklist: how to run/deploy. README covers local dev only; no record describes production deploys or rollback. The reminder cron and the API deploy together, which already caused duplicate emails once.
gapQuestions.answer: Every push to main auto-deploys both services on Render, no manual step. To roll back, open the service in the Render dashboard, go to Events, pick the last good deploy and click Rollback. Database migrations are not rolled back by Render: run prisma migrate from your laptop against prod, carefully, and take a manual backup first. The reminder cron deploys with the api service, so avoid deploying around 9am IST.
